notes: 0.4.1：两处修复。脚本详情窗多行字段（如「入口」）底部留白过大，把「历史版本」推得比其它项远，已改为按真实文字行高排版；官方脚本的历史清单 Gitee 链接改为直连 CDN，旧地址会跳转到带时效签名的地址，过期即打不开。
notes_en: 0.4.1: Two fixes. Multi-line fields in the script detail dialog (e.g. Entry) left too much blank space below, pushing 版本历史 further away than other rows; heights now follow the real text line height. And the Gitee links in official script history lists now point directly at the CDN, since the old form redirected to a time-limited signed URL that eventually stopped working.
